itemList.description: Construction of Boarding Station (Station-A), including all civil, structural, foundation and anchoring works, approach road, architectural works, passenger amenities, water supply, sanitary and drainage works, internal electrical installations, lighting, utility services, and all associated infrastructure necessary for the safe, functional and satisfactory operation of the station, complete in all respects as per approved design, drawings and specifications. (Indicative floor plans enclosed in tender document)

Supplying, installation, testing and commissioning of Rolling Stock (2 Nos) comprising traction module with traction motors, battery energy storage system, traction inverter/converter, braking system, suspension and running gear; passenger module comprising car body, seating, passenger access doors, glazing, interior fittings, lighting, ventilation, fire detection and suppression system, passenger information and communication systems, auxiliary on-board electrical systems, and all associated equipment. The scope shall also include integration with the Automated Train Control and Operations System comprising Central Control System, On board Control System, Infrastructure Management System, Communication Network, Supervisory Control Hardware and Software, diagnostics, monitoring systems, interfaces, testing, trial runs, commissioning and all accessories required for complete and satisfactory operation of the SSRT system. Includinf Import Duties, Customs Clearance and Associated Charges on Imported SSRT Equipment at 12 percent of CIF value of imported equipment

Construction of Technical Station (Station-B), including all civil, structural, foundation and anchoring works, architectural works, water supply, sanitary and drainage works, internal electrical installations, lighting, utility services, and all associated infrastructure necessary for the safe, functional and satisfactory operation of the station, complete in all respects as per approved design, drawings and specifications. (Indicative floor plans enclosed in tender document)
Testing, Trial Run & Commissiong Charges including Certification Works
